purpose: Machine-readable closure contract for 230 bounded lightweight backlog items: the original 30 plus 200 additional low-risk August-October 2026 governance, quality, privacy and product-contract microtasks.

tasks.implementation: Canonical automation registry fields are fixed and named.
Automation disposition enum is fixed to AUTOMATE/KEEP_MANUAL/MERGE/OBSOLETE/BLOCKED/NEEDS_BUSINESS_DECISION.
Schedule metadata is explicitly separated from execution-success evidence.
Duplicate scheduled work must reuse/update/merge the current owner before a new automation is created.
Business owner, trigger, provider, adapter and scheduler are separate registry dimensions.
Canonical truth precedence is fixed to current code/task owner/fresh evidence/One Brain before historical handoffs.
Stale artifacts use KEEP/FIX/MERGE_INTO/SUPERSEDED/CLOSE and one NEXT_ACTION.
Plugins are explicitly knowledge/contract packages, not daemons or runtime proof.
HAE #2033 remains the single persistent runtime; parallel brains/queues/admins are forbidden.
Executable role work binds role/plugin/contract/source/tool/write/eval/KPI/rollback/owner/QA metadata.
Business profile/citation records have a canonical minimum field set.
Profile links use canonical deep links and governed UTM attribution.
Entity names/descriptions/site/contact facts must match approved facts or remain UNKNOWN/open.
Profiles are classified by discoverability/indexability/quality/spam-risk/duplication/ownership rather than directory count.
Profile traffic, qualified actions, indexing and AI visibility are measured as separate evidence stages.
ProgressoPro content items require audience/offer/proof/canonical destination/CTA/publish/attribution/outcome fields.
Academy content follows Awareness -> Understanding -> Application with program/outcome ownership.
Threads/X research, reply, engagement and publishing are separate capabilities with no autonomous mass replies.
Instagram task skills remain under the existing Marketing owner with Design/QA handoffs instead of new agents.
Social evidence uses VIEW -> SESSION -> LEAD -> QUALIFIED_LEAD -> OPPORTUNITY -> REVENUE without collapsing stages.
Progress derives from accepted checklist/gate completion, not narrative claims.
Elapsed/duration uses started_at/updated_at/completed_at timestamps.
ETA has explicit KNOWN/ESTIMATED/WAITING_DEPENDENCY/UNKNOWN states.
Execution state vocabulary covers RUNNING/BLOCKED/DEGRADED/WAITING_FREE_AI/WAITING_OWNER/FAILED/COMPLETE with evidence and next action.
Command Center navigation contract links Admin/HAE/Agents/Plugins/One Brain and exposes local-agent online/offline without equating localhost to cloud runtime.
CI triage records exact repo/PR/head/workflow/job/step/reproduction/owner before a fix.
Failure evidence has observed_at/source_ref/exact_sha/class/evidence/reproduced/impact/safe_next/rollback/owner/qa.
Unknown failures are read first; blind rerun/redrive/provider mutation is forbidden and idempotency evidence is preserved.
Every unresolved defect has one smallest executable NEXT_ACTION.
Public evidence excludes secrets/raw PII/private health data; personal-health remains outside business ingestion.
Canonical analytics event names are fixed and reusable instead of ad-hoc per page.
Analytics payloads explicitly forbid names, email addresses, phone numbers and free-text personal messages.
MC/USDOT, contract identifiers and customer identifiers stay out of public analytics payloads.
Synthetic and internal traffic are classified separately from real visitor activity.
VIEW, SESSION, LEAD, QUALIFIED_LEAD, OPPORTUNITY and REVENUE remain distinct funnel stages.
Source, medium and campaign attribution use governed fields rather than arbitrary query-string copying.
Consent state is represented explicitly instead of being inferred from the presence of an event.
Analytics event schemas are versioned so field changes cannot silently redefine historical data.
Client-side and server-side event origins are distinguishable in evidence.
Duplicate conversion events require a deterministic deduplication key or equivalent guard.
Event evidence records route/page owner and observation time when those dimensions are material.
Conversion definitions are documented before a metric is treated as a KPI.
Revenue is never inferred from clicks, leads or proposal events.
Unknown attribution remains UNKNOWN instead of being rewritten as organic/direct by assumption.
Test and synthetic events are visibly flagged and excluded from business outcome claims.
Error telemetry must be privacy-safe and must not include raw form payloads.
Retention or historical completeness is not claimed without provider evidence.
Screenshots and exported analytics evidence must be redacted before public repository use.
Measurement availability is separated from measurement correctness in QA state.
Analytics evidence never substitutes for proof that a business outcome actually occurred.
Each commercial search intent has one canonical owner page.
Thin wording-variant doorway pages are forbidden even when they target different keyword permutations.
Canonical URLs are normalized and do not compete with alternate protocol, host or slash variants.
Only approved indexable owners belong in sitemap output.
Robots directives must not accidentally block approved commercial owners.
Hreflang alternates must reference equivalent approved pages rather than unrelated language destinations.
Title and primary heading semantics remain distinct enough to avoid accidental duplicate ownership.
Meta descriptions are written per page intent instead of copied site-wide.
Internal links support the canonical owner instead of creating competing conversion destinations.
Facets, filters and pagination must not become uncontrolled indexable search surfaces.
Structured data must describe the visible page and must not invent unsupported organization facts.
Redirect chains are treated as defects; permanent moves should converge on one canonical destination.
Missing content uses correct 404 or 410 semantics instead of soft-404 success pages.
Virtual-office or unsupported location claims are forbidden in local SEO assets.
Keyword stuffing is forbidden in headings, metadata, alt text and body copy.
Hidden text and hidden link tactics are forbidden.
PBNs, undisclosed paid links and spam-directory growth tactics are excluded.
Indexation is measured from provider evidence rather than assumed from sitemap inclusion.
GSC and Bing observations carry freshness dates so stale scans cannot override current-main evidence.
Every new indexable page requires a distinct user intent and business purpose before release.
Entity facts used for GEO or AI visibility require an approved factual source.
Business name, site and contact facts must remain consistent across governed entity surfaces.
Profiles and citations point to the canonical site destination rather than arbitrary duplicate pages.
Service-area claims require real operational support and are not inferred from target keywords.
Virtual offices and fabricated local presence are excluded from GEO expansion.
Profile ownership state is tracked separately from mere profile discovery.
Citations are evaluated for quality and relevance rather than counted as an undifferentiated total.
Duplicate profile/entity records are detected before another profile is proposed.
Profile links use governed UTM attribution when attribution is appropriate.
Discoverability and indexability are separate status fields for entity evidence.
Knowledge-graph claims require evidence and are not inferred from search snippets alone.
AI visibility is measured separately from classical search ranking.
Location pages require unique intent and locally relevant content rather than city-name substitution.
Localized entity facts must remain semantically equivalent across approved languages.
Structured organization/location data must agree with visible approved facts.
Only genuine review evidence may be referenced; fabricated review counts or sentiment are forbidden.
Competitor/entity comparisons carry an observation date because search surfaces change.
Every external GEO source record includes capture date or freshness metadata.
Unknown entity facts stay UNKNOWN instead of being completed by model inference.
Publication of an entity/profile is not treated as proof of qualified traffic, leads or revenue.
Hermes Connect registration states use an explicit lifecycle instead of ambiguous free-form status text.
Registration creation and retries preserve idempotency so one user action cannot create duplicate pilot accounts.
Email delivery state is tracked separately from account or registration state.
Automated retry behavior is bounded and cannot loop indefinitely.
Registration and delivery logs must not contain credentials or secret tokens.
English remains the default locale and unsupported locale input falls back safely.
Activation steps retain a defined order so users do not silently skip required setup state.
Share links and QR destinations resolve to canonical governed destinations.
Service add/delete operations require deterministic state and must not leave phantom services.
Booking statuses use explicit states rather than presentation-only labels.
Completed and cancelled bookings are excluded from future-booking views.
Recent Customers is derived from real booking records rather than placeholder data.
Growth opportunities are shown only when supported by product signals.
Owner/admin/private boundaries are explicit for Hermes Connect management surfaces.
PWA cache behavior must not expose stale private state across users.
User-facing failures provide a safe actionable message without leaking internal secrets.
Pilot-account creation checks for an existing matching record before creating another.
Operational evidence distinguishes configuration proof from live customer adoption.
Pilot metrics separate registrations, activated accounts, bookings and retained usage.
Production activation remains behind the existing owner/release gate.
Repair Shop management surfaces remain owner-only where the contract requires private access.
Prefilled prospect data does not become a verified business claim until the claim boundary is satisfied.
Customer CRM aggregation remains derived from booking/customer records rather than public placeholder content.
Service records use persistent identifiers so edits do not silently create duplicates.
Vehicle records use persistent identifiers and remain scoped to the authorized workspace.
Booking acceptance respects capacity constraints instead of accepting unlimited overlapping work.
No-show and follow-up states remain explicit and traceable.
Operating statuses use a governed state vocabulary rather than arbitrary display text.
Synthetic load-test tenants are clearly separated from real customer records.
Hermes driver discount logic remains a bounded contract rather than an unverified marketing claim.
Production proof runs against the approved current-main revision.
Authentication and authorization failures fail closed for private repair-shop surfaces.
Customer contact and vehicle data are excluded from public analytics and public fixtures.
Booking source markers distinguish user, internal and synthetic flows when relevant.
Fake reviews, fabricated repair outcomes and invented customer evidence are prohibited.
Repair service categories use governed identifiers rather than uncontrolled spelling variants.
Booking and schedule timestamps retain an explicit timezone context.
Cancellation state does not masquerade as successful completion in reporting.
Critical Repair Shop flows retain mobile/browser regression coverage.
Live tenant or production activation remains behind the normal release gate.
Gmail Load Board intake remains read-only at the mailbox boundary unless a separately approved write action exists.
Load Board summaries exclude private message bodies and unnecessary personal data.
Mailbox intake preserves idempotency so one message cannot create duplicate loads on replay.
Carrier, dispatcher, partner and owner workspaces keep explicit role boundaries.
Lane-preference output is recommendation evidence and not an automatic dispatch commitment.
Owner role previews are clearly identified as previews and do not silently grant production access.
The Load Board curtain and Hermes Connect handoff remain an explicit funnel boundary.
Private load/customer fields are excluded from public analytics payloads.
Every ingested load retains a traceable source reference where available.
Duplicate-load detection occurs before a second canonical record is created.
Stale load records have an explicit expiry/closed state instead of remaining indefinitely active.
Load status uses a governed state vocabulary.
Carrier access is scoped to permitted load information.
Shipper access is scoped separately from carrier/dispatcher access.
Dispatcher access does not imply owner/admin privileges.
Public examples and private operational records remain separate data classes.
Synthetic/example loads are visibly labelled and never represented as real available freight.
Live load posting or external publication remains behind the existing approval gate.
Transformation from source message to load record remains auditable.
Handoff from Load Board to Hermes Connect is explicit rather than an invisible cross-system write.
Standard carrier contract percentage variants remain explicitly versioned.
Generated contract PDFs retain a master hash/evidence reference for integrity checks.
Contract delivery is idempotent so retry cannot create uncontrolled duplicate state.
Delivery attempts retain bounded audit evidence.
The carrier receives the canonical PDF artifact when the delivery contract requires it.
Carrier delivery status and optional internal email-copy status remain separate.
Retry behavior is explicit and bounded.
Contract API origin/CORS protection remains enforced.
Delivery responses preserve the security headers required by the contract.
Signatory and carrier data are excluded from public logs and fixtures.
Contract templates carry a version so historical agreements are reproducible.
Acceptance state is explicit and not inferred from PDF generation alone.
Unsigned or unaccepted contracts cannot be treated as activated agreements.
Resend behavior reuses canonical agreement identity rather than minting an unrelated agreement.
Agreement audit evidence records an authoritative timestamp.
Delivery failures produce a failure receipt/diagnostic state without exposing secrets.
Tests must not perform provider/live contract writes.
Carrier onboarding retains browser-flow coverage for the bounded happy path.
Agreement metadata remains scoped to the authorized carrier/workspace.
Production contract activation remains behind the existing owner/release gate.
Public website hierarchy keeps one canonical destination for each principal offer.
Primary CTAs point to an approved destination and are not decorative dead ends.
Internal links used by commercial funnels must resolve successfully.
Testimonials, rankings, traffic, partner and outcome proof cannot be invented.
Pricing copy identifies the intended offer/version and avoids contradictory duplicate price claims.
Primary layouts retain an accessible main landmark.
Critical conversion flows remain usable at mobile viewport sizes.
Meaningful images receive appropriate alternative text while decorative images do not carry misleading labels.
Form controls retain accessible labels or equivalent accessible names.
Consent-dependent analytics or communication does not bypass the consent contract.
Performance claims are not made without measurement evidence.
Navigation and in-page anchors must not intentionally point to missing targets.
Not-found routes return correct failure semantics rather than a misleading successful shell.
Language switching preserves a valid destination and does not create broken locale loops.
Public contact facts must match approved organization facts.
Each page retains one clear primary heading hierarchy.
Trust/compliance pages must not contradict commercial claims.
Structured business data must match visible approved organization facts.
Conversion events use the governed analytics event registry.
Production publication remains tied to the established release owner and gates.
Every AI worker has a single Start Here entry point before reading historical journals.
Handoffs record exact branch or commit/head when code state matters.
Current-state freshness is checked before historical handoff text is treated as executable truth.
Every incomplete handoff carries one smallest executable NEXT_ACTION.
Execution ownership is named explicitly.
Tests and checks run are recorded rather than replaced by a prose claim of completion.
Evidence class is named when a conclusion depends on runtime, provider or repository evidence.
Rollback or safe-reversal information is recorded for state-changing work.
Unknowns and unresolved assumptions are written explicitly.
Secrets, credentials and session tokens are excluded from handoffs.
Full raw conversations are not copied into the repository as operational state.
Cross-agent overlap is checked before creating a second implementation owner.
Historical AI_HANDOFF entries are audit provenance, not automatically current truth.
Current code/tests and current owner decisions outrank stale agent notes.
Relevant issue/PR references are included when they define task ownership.
Stale artifacts receive KEEP/FIX/MERGE_INTO/SUPERSEDED/CLOSE classification.
Read-only inspection precedes an unexplained mutation or blind retry.
One Brain remains canonical coordination rather than spawning a second brain.
Plugins remain role/knowledge contracts and do not become independent daemon runtimes by documentation alone.
Completion is tied to accepted evidence/checks rather than the agent saying that work is done.
Repository and provider access follow least-privilege boundaries.
Passwords, API keys, OAuth tokens and session cookies are never committed to the repository.
Logs and public evidence must not leak credentials or secret-bearing payloads.
Preview/safe mode remains the default where the product contract requires it.
Merge stays behind protected review/check gates.
Deploy remains separate from code completion unless explicitly authorized.
Billing/subscription changes require the existing owner confirmation boundary.
DNS and Cloudflare account/config changes require the existing owner confirmation boundary.
Destructive deletion requires explicit authorization and a bounded target.
External communications remain separate from implementation unless sending is explicitly delegated.
Branch protection and review rules are not bypassed to make CI green.
Acceptance depends on checks for the exact current head rather than a historical green commit.
Dependency/security audit failures are treated as release evidence, not ignored noise.
State-changing work records a rollback or safe reversal path where applicable.
Force-push or destructive history rewriting is avoided for shared active review branches.
Retry/redrive paths preserve idempotency and evidence.
Public repository evidence is sanitized of raw PII and private customer data.
Synthetic fixtures are labelled and cannot be mistaken for real customers or revenue.
No automatic paid AI/provider fallback is introduced by a lightweight closure.
Owner/reviewer acceptance remains distinct from implementation-complete state.
